paragraphs: Mentioned in [Berakhot 53b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.53b.22): he posed a difficulty to Mar Zutra.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage gives Rav Yeimar bar Shelamya as the first reading and Rav Yeimar bar Shizvi as the alternative. Heilprin also lists the exchange under [bar Shelamya](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2051&lang=en) and [bar Shizvi](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2054&lang=en).
The speaker challenges Mar Zutra by citing Rav Ami’s report in Resh Lakish’s name about the time it takes to digest.
